System

Deployment, zone allocation and operational recovery

Operate a small persistent multi-zone game with measured capacities, reproducible builds, backups and a safe maintenance procedure. A dedicated UE process is a zone simulator, not a complete hosting or matchmaking platform.

Scope and player interaction

Operate a small persistent multi-zone game with measured capacities, reproducible builds, backups and a safe maintenance procedure. A dedicated UE process is a zone simulator, not a complete hosting or matchmaking platform.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase22committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Booting → Registering → Ready → Draining → Unhealthy → Restarting → Offline

WBP_Diagnostics observes results from URPGZoneHeartbeatComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Deployment_Development. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
ZoneProcessId, BuildId, CatalogHash, RegionId: immutable registration metadata
HeartbeatSequence/LastSeen: monotonic liveness record
Capacity/Reservations/ActiveSessions: allocator counters, not a promised concurrency level
DrainDeadline: server-controlled UTC timestamp
BackupId/SchemaVersion/RestoreTestId: operational evidence
ServerTick/CPU/Memory/NetworkUsage: measured telemetry with timestamp

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGZoneHeartbeatComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_DiagnosticsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RegisterZone(ProcessIdentity, BuildId, ZoneDefinitionId) -> Lease|IncompatibleBuild
ReportHeartbeat(Sequence, CapacityMetrics) -> Accepted|Stale
ReserveDestination(CharacterId, ZoneId) -> Reservation|ZoneFull|Unavailable
BeginDrain(Deadline, MaintenanceReason) -> Draining
RestoreStagingBackup(BackupId) -> VerificationReport; operator procedure, not a game RPC

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Build a versioned client and dedicated-server package from the same pinned engine/plugin/content revision; keep symbols and server logs privately.
  2. Start PostgreSQL and one authenticated backend, apply checked migrations, then start two zone processes with separate IDs/ports and service credentials supplied outside content.
  3. Each zone registers its zone/catalog/build and begins admitting players only after definitions, persistence adapter and safe spawns are ready.
  4. Allocator chooses a compatible zone with reserved capacity; it must count in-flight reservations to avoid overfilling.
  5. On maintenance, stop new admissions/economic starts, settle commands, snapshot/fence sessions and offer safe reconnect/transfer. Terminate only after the drain policy or explicit failure handling.
  6. Backups include database and required server configuration metadata; restore to an isolated environment and reconcile ledger/inventory/quest/session invariants before declaring the backup usable.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Document local ports explicitly: proposal backend HTTPS 7443, Zone_A game 7777 and Zone_B game 7787; firewall only required client game/admission paths. Validate actual packaged network configuration on the chosen platform.
  2. Create DA_Deployment_Development containing nonsecret region/build/capacity settings. Keep all connection secrets in deployment secret storage or protected environment injection.
  3. Launch the packaged dedicated-server executable using its actual generated name and map argument from the build; record the command from that build rather than copying an imaginary executable.
  4. Open L_LoadTest with the same relevant actor populations as Rillmere: players, AI, nodes, projectiles and widgets on clients. A bare empty map is not a capacity proof.
  5. Prepare runbooks for backend outage, database restore, zone crash, network partition, credential rotation, rollback and maintenance cancellation.
  6. Run restore tests against disposable staging identities and check total balances, item uniqueness, reward receipts, session fences and content compatibility before permitting login.

Reopen Phase22 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_LoadTest / Zone_A and Zone_B / backend staging database. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Heartbeat lost -> allocator stops new reservations; existing session authority is determined by lease/fencing, not heartbeat alone.
Zone full -> ZoneFull with retry/alternate compatible destination; do not disconnect source before a valid handoff plan.
Database unavailable -> economic actions reject/pend safely; no client-local fallback save.
Restore older database -> invalidate old tickets/epochs and reconcile acknowledged operations against recovery policy; never silently replay client receipts as grants.
Bad patch -> drain, restore compatible binaries/catalog and use a supported schema rollback/forward-fix; no untested down migration in production.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Begin with two to eight real clients and then measured 16/32-client tests. Proposed initial zone capacity 16 is a configuration ceiling for testing, not evidence it performs acceptably. Regional deployment starts with one region.

Track admission failure, heartbeat age, reservations, save latency, command retry, database pool saturation, tick time and p95/p99 packet rates. Alert on sustained service health and invariants, not every transient timeout.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
